MACRO.label: MacroSentinel
MACRO.description: Weekly. Reads 8 economic indicators (Alpha Vantage) and writes a risk regime to macro_signals. Consumed by ResearchAgent's macro score, DeepDive, and Mentor. Purely advisory — never places or blocks a trade by itself.
MACRO.addReason: Give every downstream score a macro context input.

RESEARCH.label: ResearchAgent
RESEARCH.description: Daily (Mon-Fri, 9:00 ET). Scores each tracked symbol across 5 dimensions (fundamental/technical/sentiment/macro/insider) into an analyst_score, using the promoted CHAMPION weights when one exists (the closed learning loop) and each symbol's recent score TREND as context. Writes agent_signals + appends signal_score_history. Research Journal: agent_signals inserts now capture the returned row id (signal_id was previously always null downstream), decision_observations.features.screener records which dual-bucket screener criteria flagged a candidate, and a pipeline_stage_events row is written per candidate (stage='research', passed/rejected + reason) — the first link in a full pipeline trail (research -> portfolio constructor -> execution). [2026-07-12] LLM now per-flow from Settings->AI Models (agent_config, default deepseek-reasoner), not hardcoded. India inputs added: GDELT news tone -> sentiment_score (lib/india-news.ts), and live NSE FII/DII net flows injected into the India thesis prompt (lib/india-macro.ts). Emits a low-confidence-research:<market> System Health alert when >=50% of a run's symbols score on <2 of 5 dimensions (quality gap, not just quota).
RESEARCH.addReason: Central scoring engine — everything downstream keys off its analyst_score.
RESEARCH.changeReason: Research Journal — wired signal_id through and added screener/stage instrumentation (Decision 40).

SCOREHIST.label: signal_score_history
SCOREHIST.description: Append-only per-symbol score log (migration 054/055). Never mutated after insert. Feeds the Score Tracker chart AND is read back by ResearchAgent as trend context so it reasons about rising/falling conviction, not a cold snapshot.
SCOREHIST.addReason: The score-history data model — previously the trajectory chart had no durable source.

CHAMPION.label: Champion weights
CHAMPION.description: The promoted strategy_versions row (is_champion=true) whose weights_snapshot ResearchAgent reads. This is where a human-approved LearnerAgent improvement finally takes effect. Before 2026-07-05 nothing read it — the loop was open and approved learning evaporated. Phase 4: ONE champion PER MARKET (strategy_versions.market) — an India stock scores off India-learned weights, a US stock off US weights. India's champion is seeded as a clone of the US champion (a prior) and diverges as India accrues its own trades.
CHAMPION.addReason: Closes the learning loop — Learner learns → you promote → Research scores differently.
CHAMPION.changeReason: Per-market champions — India rides a US-cloned prior until it earns its own weights.

TRADER.label: PaperTrader
TRADER.description: Deterministic flow (no LLM). Reads pending agent_signals with analyst_score >= threshold and direction long, and opens paper_positions + paper_trades via a transactional RPC (execute_paper_fill, migration 071 — one DB transaction, row-locked). Long-only. Phase 4: fills EACH signal into ITS market's own pool in native currency — US in USD, India in ₹; currencies never summed. Phase 2: sizing is conviction-scaled (half-Kelly from a calibrated P(win) model + the ledger's MFE/|MAE| payoff ratio, falling back to the flat position_size_pct until 60+ matured observations exist) and R:R is dynamic (stop/target from the ledger's actual MAE/MFE percentiles, falling back to the fixed profile stop/target) — both a signal's own price_target/stop_loss always win. The Portfolio Constructor (lib/portfolio/constructor.ts) then shrinks that proposed size against the live book (name/sector/gross/vol/correlation limits) before any cash moves. Research Journal: writes a pipeline_stage_events row at both decision points (stage='portfolio_constructor' passed/shrunk/rejected, stage='execution' filled/rejected), keyed by the same signal_id ResearchAgent originated — completing the funnel trail. Triggering (2026-07-08): fills are now driven by STANDALONE per-market crons (kairos-paper-trade-us 10:05 ET, kairos-paper-trade-india 16:35 IST; migration 128) — the research→paper-trade chain remains a temporary backstop. This decouples fills from a hung research run (the US 0-fills bug). Same-trading-day freshness gate: only pending long signals created on the current market-local calendar day (America/New_York US, Asia/Kolkata India) are eligible; older pending are marked status='expired', never filled. Claim ownership (agent_signals.claim_run_id/claimed_at, migration 126) + two CAS gates (route pending→claiming, RPC claiming→paper_traded clearing the claim, migration 127) let the chain and the standalone cron run concurrently without double-filling. Re-entry cooldown (2026-07-09): same-symbol BUY is blocked for 5 calendar days after a position in that symbol closes. Pyramid gate (2026-07-09): if an open position exists, a new BUY is only allowed if fillPrice > avg_cost — averaging DOWN is blocked entirely.
TRADER.addReason: Turns qualifying signals into paper positions.
TRADER.changeReason: 2026-07-09: Re-entry cooldown (5 calendar days after close blocks same-symbol BUY) + pyramid gate (only add to existing position if fillPrice > avg_cost — no averaging down). Prior (2026-07-08): standalone per-market fill crons + same-trading-day freshness + claim ownership.

MONITOR.label: PositionMonitor
MONITOR.description: Daily post-close (Mon-Fri, 16:15 ET). Refreshes current_price for every held symbol, then runs exit logic in priority order: (1) llm_exit flag set by LearnerAgent, (2) time stop — closes positions older than champion genome's horizon_days (default 10d), (3) daily score-exit — sell when analyst_score falls below exit threshold, (4) trailing stop (own initial_stop_loss distance from peak, never below initial stop), (5) price target — partial profit-taking: sells half at target, moves stop to breakeven on remainder (only when qty ≥ 2). After exits: benchmark sync fetches VOO/^NSEI daily price and upserts paper_performance.bench_nav; NAV drawdown circuit breaker auto-pauses app_paused=true + critical System Health alert if weekly NAV drops >5%. Owns ALL exits. Writes decision_journal.
MONITOR.changeReason: Added time stop (age > genome horizon_days), partial profit-taking at target (close half, move stop to breakeven), NAV drawdown circuit breaker (auto-pause at >5% weekly drop + critical alert), and benchmark sync (VOO/^NSEI daily price into paper_performance.bench_nav).

EXITS.label: Exit + close
EXITS.description: On any exit trigger, deletes the paper_positions row, marks the matching paper_trades closed with realized P&L / outcome, credits cash once, and logs a decision_journal entry. These closed outcomes are the LearnerAgent's training corpus.
EXITS.addReason: Single close path so cash is credited exactly once.

LEARNER.label: LearnerAgent
LEARNER.description: Weekly (Friday). Evaluates a market's closed-trade cohort and proposes weight-change CHALLENGERS into strategy_versions — it does NOT mutate live weights or sell live positions. Gated by a phase gate (10+ closed trades) and an auto-guard. Phase 4: analyzes ONE market per run (US today) and proposes challengers ONLY for that market's champion, so a bad India run can never shift US weights. India gets its own cohort once it clears the 10+ closed-trade gate.
LEARNER.addReason: Learn from outcomes and evolve the scoring weights.
LEARNER.changeReason: Per-market cohorts + per-market challengers — India learning can't contaminate US. (Also: no longer timer-sells; reconciliation only.)

CHALLENGER.label: Challenger weights
CHALLENGER.description: An immutable strategy_versions row (is_champion=false) holding a proposed weight change. Inert until a human promotes it — the architecture gate that stops the AI silently overwriting the live strategy.

GENOME.label: Strategy Genome
GENOME.description: Phase 3 learning-core (strategy_versions.genome jsonb, migration 063). Extends what a challenger can evolve beyond the 5 top-level weights: entry threshold, horizon, exit family (ledger-percentile stops/targets — the same math Phase 2's dynamic R:R already uses), sizing mode, universe, regime router. Hard search-domain bounds enforced in code (lib/validation/genome.ts), not just documented — an out-of-bounds proposal is rejected before it can reach validation. A genome-less strategy_versions row scores exactly as before (legacy 5-weight path) — fully additive.
GENOME.addReason: Reweighting 5 fixed dials can only remix existing assumptions — the genome gives evolution more to actually change.

REGISTRY.label: Feature Registry
REGISTRY.description: Phase 3 learning-core (feature_registry table, migration 064). LearnerAgent's new propose_feature tool proposes a machine-readable spec (rationale, formula, inputs, falsification test) — the formula is NEVER executed as code, only interpreted through a whitelisted expression grammar (lib/validation/feature-compiler.ts: + - * / and log/abs/min/max/lag only, tokenized + parsed, no eval()). A weekly feature-check job (app/api/validation/feature-check) computes out-of-sample Spearman rank-IC across walk-forward folds; promotes proposed→quarantined→active on |IC|>=0.03 & p<0.1 across 2+ of 3 folds, auto-retires actives whose rolling IC falls below 0.01 for 3 checks. Only 'active' features ever reach the calibration fit — proposing a feature has ZERO effect on live scoring.
REGISTRY.addReason: Edge compounds through discovering, validating, and retiring features — not just remixing a fixed 5-dimension scorecard.

SHADOW.label: Shadow Decisions
SHADOW.description: Phase 3 learning-core (shadow_decisions table, migration 065). ResearchAgent records what up to 3 strategy_versions in state='shadow_paper' would have decided on every candidate — pure scoring replay, no fills, no cash, alongside the champion's real decision. Off by default: nothing enters shadow_paper without explicit action (or a bounded weekly auto-promotion gated by strategy_config.exploration_enabled, default false). Lets a challenger's edge be observed against live, contemporaneous opportunities before it ever risks paper capital.
SHADOW.addReason: Offline backtests alone can't expose live feature availability or changing market structure; live paper capital is unsafe to risk on an unvalidated challenger. Shadow bridges the two.

VALIDATE.label: Validation Engine
VALIDATE.description: Phase 2 learning-core (lib/validation/engine.ts, migration 061). Deterministic, NO LLM — replays champion vs challenger weights as a scoring-REPLAY against purged/embargoed walk-forward folds from the decision ledger (lib/learning/dataset.ts), then requires evidence before a challenger may be promoted: p_improvement >= 0.80 (1000-draw moving-block bootstrap, fixed seed), paired-diff CI floor, n_effective (overlap-adjusted) >= 12, wins >= 3 of 5 folds. Writes a validation_experiments row every run (pass or fail). The promote_champion route is FAIL-CLOSED on this — no passed experiment, no promotion (a journaled force_unvalidated override exists but is not the default path). Fires automatically when LearnerAgent creates a challenger; also runnable on demand (Validate button, Agents page).
VALIDATE.addReason: Human approval alone was governance, not evidence — a persuasive-but-wrong challenger could become the live scoring policy. This makes promotion require walk-forward proof.

PROMOTE.label: You promote (Strategy Registry)
PROMOTE.description: Human review step — now the FINAL gate after evidence, not a substitute for it. Promoting a challenger in the Strategy Registry flips it to champion (blocked with HTTP 412 unless VALIDATE passed) — and ResearchAgent actually consumes it on its next run.
PROMOTE.addReason: Keep a human in control of what the AI is allowed to change.
PROMOTE.changeReason: Now sits AFTER the Validation Engine gate, not instead of it — see VALIDATE.

MENTOR.label: MentorAgent
MENTOR.description: Reads your trade outcomes + learner runs and writes coaching insights (mentor_insights). Advisory to YOU — does not touch positions or weights.
MENTOR.addReason: Coach the human, not just the portfolio.

REALORDER.label: Manual real-order execution (Robinhood)
REALORDER.description: Robinhood has no public order API, so live trading through it stays manual by design. Approving a proposal generates an exact natural-language command to paste into a Claude session with Robinhood MCP access (account 605420660 only). The app never claims a fill it didn't make.
REALORDER.addReason: execClaude cannot actually call broker tools — a generated command keeps the human in the loop instead of faking fills.
REALORDER.changeReason: GATEWAY (below) now covers Alpaca-backed paper orders; Robinhood stays manual since it has no API.

GATEWAY.label: Execution Gateway (broker registry: Alpaca/Kite)
GATEWAY.description: Typed broker order lifecycle for approved trade_proposals, routed through lib/brokers/registry.ts (getActiveBroker per market, strategy_config.active_broker_us/india) instead of a direct Alpaca import: submit -> pending_submit/submitted/partially_filled/filled/canceled/rejected, polled + reconciled every 30 min (app/api/broker/orders/sync — now iterates DISTINCT brokers present in open orders, so Alpaca and Kite orders can be in-flight simultaneously). A 'Send to Alpaca (paper)' button on Smart Money's Trade Queue (status='approved' only) fires this — human click required, never cron-fired. Adding a future broker (E*TRADE etc.) is one adapter file + one registry line, zero route changes. Fixed a discovered pre-existing bug in the original build: the Trade Queue UI read a separate, never-populated `trade_queue` table while Approve/Reject/the Gateway all operate on `trade_proposals` — repointed. Live-env orders require strategy_config.trading_enabled=true (global master switch, off by default) AND the market-specific trading_enabled_us/trading_enabled_india flag (both default true, independently toggleable in Settings → Agents — turning one off blocks only new live orders for that market, holdings/balances stay fully viewable); only the PAPER path is verified live.
GATEWAY.addReason: First typed (non-manual) execution path — the honest gap flagged when auditing risk-reward/execution architecture earlier this session. Broker-swappable by design (see lib/brokers registry pattern already used for Alpaca/Kite reads).
GATEWAY.changeReason: Ops spec Part 2: routes now go through a typed broker adapter registry instead of a direct Alpaca import — multi-broker (Alpaca US / Kite India) support with zero-route-change swapping. Later same day: added independent per-market trading_enabled_us/trading_enabled_india view-only-vs-auto-trading toggle, separate from the Kite disconnect kill-switch.

YAHOO.label: Yahoo .NS data (India)
YAHOO.description: Free Yahoo Finance is the India data source (Kite Personal tier has no market data). The chart endpoint gives price + candles (no auth); the cookie+crumb quoteSummary gives fundamentals (P/E, ROE, margins). Mapped into the same shape the US scorer expects, so Indian stocks run the identical 5-dimension pipeline. Candidates come from a static NIFTY-50 list.
YAHOO.addReason: Score real NSE stocks on free data, keyed off market_focus = India.

INDIA.label: India signals
INDIA.description: Indian stocks are scored + tracked (Score Tracker, /dashboard/india) AND (Phase 4) paper-traded in their own ₹ pool — no longer excluded. The old single-USD-pool constraint is gone: PaperTrader now keeps a separate India ₹ pool so INR fills never corrupt US NAV. India is ALSO acted on via real Kite orders (the /dashboard/india confirm path). Gated by market_focus including India — a non-destructive toggle.
INDIA.addReason: Track India like US without corrupting the USD paper NAV.
INDIA.changeReason: India now paper-trades in its own ₹ pool (Phase 4) — closes India's learning loop.

NSE.label: NSE direct feeds (India)
NSE.description: Direct NSE India JSON (free, cookie handshake — lib/nse-data.ts) for the things Yahoo can't give: the full ~2000-name equity universe (EQUITY_L.csv → nightly india_screen_cache for the full-market Scanner), SEBI insider disclosures (corporates-pit), and option-chain OI/PCR ('options flow'). Fails soft — NSE geo-throttles some non-India IPs, so callers fall back to Yahoo/NIFTY-100 with an honest note. Feeds the India Scanner + Smart Money panels, not the agent loop directly.
NSE.addReason: Lift the two free-data ceilings (full-market scan + India insider/options) Yahoo alone couldn't.

LEDGER.label: Decision ledger
LEDGER.description: Phase 1 learning-core (decision_observations + observation_labels, migrations 059/060). Every candidate ResearchAgent scores — filled OR rejected — writes an immutable point-in-time observation (raw features, availability mask, weights used, score, action). A nightly label-maturation cron computes forward-horizon (2/5/10/20d) benchmark-neutral returns + MAE/MFE once each horizon matures, WITHOUT leaking future data into the features. LearnerAgent's query_score_correlation now reads this ledger first (all candidates, horizon-aligned, benchmark-neutral) instead of the old fills-only, policy-P&L, symbol-keyed join.
LEDGER.addReason: Fix the learning label — the old dataset was fills-only, policy-P&L (not alpha), and joined by symbol (collision-prone). This is the ground truth the whole learning/evolution roadmap (Phases 2-3) is built on.

KITE.label: Zerodha Kite (India execution)
KITE.description: Real NSE/BSE orders via Kite Connect (Personal tier). Human-in-the-loop: user-initiated from /dashboard/india with an explicit confirm — never cron/agent-fired. Kite's token expires daily (SEBI requirement), so a one-click login each trading morning re-arms it; reads/orders degrade to a 'reconnect' state when stale. Every Kite submit passes one choke point, placeEquityOrder(), which runs verifyKiteTradingIdentity(): it fetches Kite /user/profile and requires the connected token's user_id to match strategy_config.active_account_india AND an allowlisted broker_accounts{broker=kite,role=trading} row — a wrong/rotated token or unset account fails closed (403/500/502).
KITE.addReason: The one thing free India data can't do — real execution.
KITE.changeReason: Codex Phase-B re-review #2/#3: identity gate moved from allowlist-text-only to a verified check (Kite /user/profile user_id must equal active_account_india) at the placeEquityOrder choke point, so the canonical/autonomous/exit paths get the same floor as the standalone route — not just the route.

HEALTH.label: Health-Triage
HEALTH.description: Every 6h + on demand. Read-only SRE agent: reads open agent_alerts, recent agent_runs errors, v_decision_quality taint rate, and provider budgets; writes an advisory triage (root cause + suggested fix) to health_triage, surfaced on the dashboard System Health card. Model configurable in Settings. NEVER changes config, orders, weights, or code. Before reading agent_alerts it runs checkRobinhoodTokenHealth which attempts a CAS refresh of the short-lived RH access token and reports/resolves broker-token:robinhood only on a genuinely failed/absent refresh, so the token is kept warm every 6h and a real dead-refresh is caught even when no order/snapshot path ran; the same check backs GET /api/robinhood-mcp/status so the Settings badge shows Reconnect required instead of a false Connected.
HEALTH.addReason: Self-healing Part B: surface + explain system issues without any autonomous remediation of money/config/code.
HEALTH.changeReason: Wired proactive broker-token check into the 6h triage + Robinhood status route: attempts the CAS refresh on the short-lived RH access token and alerts only on a genuinely failed/absent refresh (avoids false alarms on routine short-TTL rollover), closing the gap where a dead RH refresh token silently dropped all RH accounts out of holding-risk and froze live_account_snapshots. Advisory; owner reconnects OAuth manually only on failed refresh.

WATCHDOG.label: Watchdog
WATCHDOG.description: Every 2h janitor (migration 131). Reaps zombie agent_runs (status='running' past 15min), reverts orphaned 'claiming' signals to pending + clears claim stamps, and expires stale pending long signals per market-local day. Bounded status corrections only — never money/positions/ledgers/config.
WATCHDOG.addReason: Paper-fill reliability: reap the zombie runs + stuck claims + stale pending the US 0-fills bug created; keep the signal lifecycle clean.

EDGELAB.label: EdgeScout / EdgeIC (measure-only factor lab)
EDGELAB.description: Deterministic price/volume edge library + Information-Coefficient gate (features/edge-factor-discovery, P0/P1). Computes edge_signals + edge_ic_history and an advisory edge lifecycle status, surfaced read-only on /dashboard/edges. MEASURE-ONLY: never feeds analyst_score, agent_signals, paper fills, sizing, or any live order. The broad-universe IC run found the simple price/volume edges do NOT clear the significance bar yet — the gate correctly refused to promote them.
EDGELAB.addReason: Move discovery from LLM-invents-themes toward validated deterministic factors; measure IC before anything trades.

AUTOSHADOW.label: AutonomousShadow
AUTOSHADOW.description: Weekdays 07:30 UTC (Vercel cron, 30 min after research). Reads qualifying agent_signals (score_source='deterministic_v1', direction=long, score≥threshold, last 24h). Runs the 9-gate execution kernel (lib/trading/execution-kernel.ts evaluateAutonomousExecution) and the Kelly sizing kernel (computeAutonomousSizing) for each. Creates trade_proposals with execution_mode='autonomous_shadow'. Gate 1 (AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=false in current deployment) makes every proposal land manual_review_required — intentional until all L4 launch blockers are cleared. No broker call, no budget reservation, no order submission. NAV from live_account_snapshots (account 605420660, read-only); Kelly from last 100 closed paper_trades; budget dry-run reads broker_orders spend today (informational). Journals each run to decision_journal.
AUTOSHADOW.addReason: PA1/PA2 shadow autonomous path — accumulate evidence that the kernel gates behave correctly before enabling live orders.

SHADOWPROP.label: Shadow trade_proposals
SHADOWPROP.description: trade_proposals rows with execution_mode='autonomous_shadow'. Status is queued_auto (all 9 gates + sizing passed) or manual_review_required (any gate/sizing failure). In the current deployment, AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=false means gate 1 always fires → all land manual_review_required. Owner can review these in the UI; no auto-promotion or broker submit path exists yet.
SHADOWPROP.addReason: Audit trail for autonomous shadow decisions without any financial exposure.

AUTOLIVE.label: AutonomousLive
AUTOLIVE.description: Weekdays 14:00 UTC (Vercel cron, after research at 13:00 UTC). Reads qualifying agent_signals for markets in autonomous mode (live_auto_mode_us/india='autonomous' in strategy_config). Dual gate: BOTH deployment env var AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=true AND DB toggle live_auto_enabled must be true; neither alone allows orders. Runs the same 9-gate execution kernel (evaluateAutonomousExecution) and Kelly sizing kernel (computeAutonomousSizing) as the shadow path. Per market: US orders via direct Robinhood REST (lib/brokers/robinhood/rest-client.ts — OAuth token from api_key_vault; no MCP in serverless); India orders via Kite REST (placeEquityOrder in lib/kite.ts). Budget reserved atomically via reserve_live_order_budget_v2 RPC with p_execution_actor='autonomous_worker'. Writes broker_orders + appends broker_order_events (actor_kind='autonomous_live'). Proposals land queued_auto (submitted) or manual_review_required (any gate/sizing/RPC/broker failure). Per-market: US and India independently toggled — autonomous mode on one doesn't affect the other. Current deployment: AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=false, so cron is a no-op until owner sets env var AND enables DB toggle.
AUTOLIVE.addReason: PA3 autonomous live execution — agents evaluate signals and submit live orders directly (no per-order owner click) when deployment flag + DB toggle + 9 gates all clear.

LIVEAUDIT.label: Live order audit (broker_orders + broker_order_events)
LIVEAUDIT.description: broker_orders: typed order lifecycle (submitted → filled/rejected/canceled), polled by broker-sync cron. broker_order_events: append-only audit trail (boe_block_mutation trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE) — every status transition written with actor_kind='autonomous_live' and auto_run_id linking back to the AutonomousLive run. Together they form the immutable record of every live order the autonomous path has ever attempted.
LIVEAUDIT.addReason: Immutable audit trail for all autonomous live order activity — required for reconciliation and owner review.

PERFTRUTH.label: Performance Truth Layer
PERFTRUTH.description: Deterministic, mandate-aware, append-only evaluation layer (migrations 133/134/135). investment_mandates table seeds default mandates ('Swing US 2-20d' / 'Swing India 2-20d') with benchmark symbols (VOO/NIFTY50.NS). mandate_id is stamped on agent_signals, paper_trades, decision_observations so trades attribute to a mandate. strategy_evaluations (append-only, trigger-guarded) stores evaluation snapshots: book Sharpe/Sortino/MaxDD/win-rate/alpha/cost-adjusted-return/exec-slip vs modeled, plus opp_* opportunity columns (null in P0, populated in P1). lib/evaluation/run-evaluation.ts is pure deterministic math — no LLM, no weight mutation. UI: mandate selector + 'Run Evaluation' button + eval history table on /dashboard/learning. eligible_for_live_review is advisory ONLY — never read by broker gateway. P1 gate cron (weekly Sunday 02:00 UTC) counts closed evaluable trades per market; surfaces System Health info alert when ≥ 20 accumulate (signals P1 opportunity-level IC is ready to build).
PERFTRUTH.addReason: Mandate-aware truth ledger that answers 'did this strategy create repeatable benchmark-relative edge?' before promotion gates can fire. Deterministic — no LLM in the evaluation path.

ACCTBOOK.label: Live account book
ACCTBOOK.description: Read-only, post-close broker positions for ALL live accounts, fetched fresh per run through the Robinhood agentic MCP (cloud JSON-RPC at agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading, authenticated by the shared-vault OAuth token — NOT the classic REST API, which 401s 'rejected client id' for this token, and NOT the retired Windows-Scheduler claude-exec capture). captureAllRobinhoodAccounts() in lib/robinhood-mcp.ts opens one MCP session, get_accounts enumerates all 6 RH accounts, then per account get_equity_positions + get_portfolio, plus a batched get_equity_quotes over the deduped held symbols to price holdings. agentic_allowed gates ORDER PLACEMENT only (true for 605420660 alone); READS succeed for all 6 accounts, so every account (605420660 + 965848641 + the 4 others) flows into holding-risk. Plus Zerodha Kite India. Supplies per-account holdings (qty, current price, average cost, market value), fresh quotes, and per-symbol candle history to the HoldingRisk engine. HoldingRisk never places, cancels, or modifies any order against these accounts — it only reads them.
ACCTBOOK.addReason: Daily Per-Holding Risk Analytics needs a settled, coherent post-close snapshot of every live account to score. Modeled as its own read-only source so the diagram makes clear the risk engine consumes broker positions but touches no order path.
ACCTBOOK.changeReason: Repointed the live source from the dead Robinhood REST client (401 for the MCP-scoped token — never returned holdings) to captureAllRobinhoodAccounts() over the agentic MCP, enumerating ALL 6 accounts (was only picking up the single active account / falling to an 'unknown' skip). fetchRobinhoodBrokerAccounts() and refreshViaMcp() now both consume the MCP multi-account capture; agentic_allowed=false blocks orders but not reads.

HOLDINGRISK.label: HoldingRisk
HOLDINGRISK.description: Daily Per-Holding Risk Analytics engine (spec: features/holding-risk-daily/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE.md; tables holding_risk_runs + holding_risk_snapshots + account_risk_snapshots via migrations 154/155, append-only + UPDATE/DELETE-blocking triggers + owner-email RLS; cron migration 156). Fires POST /api/agents/holding-risk?market=us|india once per weekday after the respective exchange close AND after the authoritative account-snapshot refresh (US 21:30 UTC, India 11:00 UTC). HYBRID design: lib/risk/holding-risk.ts computes a deterministic 'risk-control pressure index' 0-100 (component caps name 30 / sector 20 / vol-beta 15 / cluster 15 / drawdown 10 / liquidity 10) AND the risk posture (hold / trim / exit_review / review / insufficient_data) with strict precedence (verified protective-stop or thesis-break -> exit_review; drawdown ALONE never; hard concentration/cluster breach -> trim; data confidence <0.5 -> review). An LLM writes ONLY the human-readable strategy_note explanation — it CANNOT change the score, posture, or action. Fails closed (publishes a failed/insufficient-data run, never yesterday-as-today) when a broker snapshot is missing/stale. No cross-currency roll-up (USD and INR never summed). Formula stamped hr-v1. This engine is ADVISORY-ONLY: the strategy line reaches NO order path for ANY account and applies to read-only 965848641 identically.
HOLDINGRISK.addReason: Owner asked for live per-holding risk analytics — score, posture, and a plain-language strategy note per holding across all live accounts, recomputed daily. Built deterministic-first (engine owns score + posture) so an LLM can explain but never move a risk control or an order.

RISKDASH.label: /dashboard/risk — Daily Per-Holding Risk panel
RISKDASH.description: Portfolio Risk page (components/dashboard/PortfolioRiskPage.tsx) 'Daily Per-Holding Risk' section. Reads GET /api/portfolio/risk-daily?market=&accountId= (owner-email RLS scoped, complete runs only, one latest run per account, previous run matched on same formula_version for honest Delta-vs-yesterday). Renders per-account tabs, a cadence header (Daily badge, last computed, data-as-of, formula version, data confidence), a missing-inputs banner, and an expandable per-holding table: score chip, posture pill, 1-day score delta, risk-driver breakdown, and the LLM strategy_note labeled 'advisory'. Read-only accounts additionally show 'advisory only · no order path'. A footer disclaimer states score + posture are deterministic and the strategy note cannot change them. Consumes the risk snapshots; produces no signals and touches no order path.
RISKDASH.addReason: Surfaces the daily per-holding risk score, posture, drivers, and advisory strategy note to the owner on the existing Portfolio Risk page, per-account and per-currency, with explicit advisory-only framing.

Taint rule: quality_status=ok AND data_confidence<0.5 → tainted=true. quality_status=unknown → never auto-tainted in Phase 1B. All excluded_from_learning=false until Phase 2 gates learning on clean data. Atomic: trade and quality metadata land together or both fail.

history.label: Trade-history RAG memory loop (Strategic Report Tier-3/Tier-4, all 17 items)
history.reason: Closed a retrieval-augmented memory loop across the pipeline. WRITE side: on close, PositionMonitor and LearnerAgent call indexClosedTrade() — builds a deterministic setup document, embeds it with Voyage voyage-3.5 (1024-dim) and upserts into trade_memories (migration 118, pgvector HNSW, cosine). READ side: before scoring a candidate, ResearchAgent calls retrieveSimilarTrades() — embeds the live setup, ANN-matches prior setups via match_trade_memories RPC, reranks with Voyage rerank-2 (#9), and appends a 'prior similar setups (X/Y were wins)' note to the thesis prompt so the LLM sees its own track record on lookalike setups. Cross-cutting layers built same change: #11 binary ticker context filter + #12 Anthropic contextual retrieval headers (lib/rag/contextual.ts); #13 vector store = pgvector 0.8.0 already in Supabase (no external DB); #14 durable rag_traces (migration 119) mirrored to WandB Weave when keyed (lib/observability/weave.ts); #16 native document ingestion pipeline into doc_chunks (migration 120); #15 native StateGraph orchestrator + #17 typed A2A message contracts (lib/agents/). Idempotent backfill route /api/agents/rag-backfill indexes historical closed trades. All embedding/rerank/trace paths are env-gated: absent VOYAGE_API_KEY → graceful no-op, never throws.

history.label: Autonomy ladder master money-safety gate (07/08 review S1 / Build 1)
history.reason: Added strategy_config.autonomy_level (migration 124, default L3_live_manual) as a single declared maturity level gating the live-order path. Both live gateways (US app/api/broker/orders and India app/api/kite/order) now call liveOrdersAllowed(level) from lib/autonomy.ts ABOVE the trading_enabled check: live orders are refused unless level >= L3_live_manual, so L0/L1/L2 block all live orders outright. Levels L4_live_small_auto and L5_scaled_auto are DEFINED-BUT-NOT-HONORED: AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED is hard-false, and requireOwner() still gates every live order, so no autonomous live placement path exists. Default preserves prior owner-click live-manual behavior exactly (nothing newly blocked or allowed). Additive migration; behavior change is a new gateway table-column dependency, not an agent-to-agent flow.

Promoted champion's genome (entry threshold, exit stop/target percentiles + horizon, Kelly sizing cap/floor/mode) now drives ResearchAgent + PaperTrader via lib/validation/genome-live.ts. Previously only the 5 scoring weights were consumed; the rest of the genome was recorded but inert. Genome size cap clamped to owner position_size_pct (loop sizes down, never above owner limit). Default genome preserves prior fixed behavior; change is live only after a genome-bearing challenger passes the fail-closed validation gate and owner promotion.

history.label: PaperTrader — standalone per-market fill crons + same-trading-day freshness + claim ownership
history.reason: Fixed the US ~0-paper-fills bottleneck starving the learning/metrics/evolution loop. Root cause: paper fills only ran as a tail-call chained at the END of /api/agents/research/cron; when the US research run hung before that chain, zero US fills landed while stale pending signals piled up (10+ days old). India research is lighter, completes, and chains fine — the entire US/India asymmetry. Fix (migrations 126–128): (126) agent_signals.claim_run_id/claimed_at claim-ownership columns + market_trading_day_start(market) helper (America/New_York US, Asia/Kolkata India, DST-correct) + indexes; (127) execute_paper_fill now clears the claim stamps on its claiming→paper_traded CAS; (128) standalone kairos-paper-trade-us (10:05 ET) and kairos-paper-trade-india (16:35 IST) crons. The route now selects ONLY fresh same-market-local-day pending long signals (freshness enforced in the query so stale high-score signals can't crowd out fresh ones), marks older pending status='expired' (never fills them), claims with ownership, reverts only rows it owns, uses the market-local day for the daily notional cap window, and finalizes its agent_runs row in the catch so a throw can't leave a zombie 'running' row. The research→paper-trade chain stays as a temporary backstop (Phase 3 removes it after 2–3 clean standalone days); claim ownership + the two CAS gates make chain+cron overlap double-fill-safe.

history.label: Watchdog — pipeline janitor cron
history.reason: New every-2h janitor (migration 131 + app/api/agents/watchdog). Reaps zombie agent_runs (status='running' past 15min, longer than any Vercel function can live), reverts orphaned 'claiming' signals to pending and clears the claim stamps, and expires stale pending long signals per market-local day. Bounded status corrections only — never touches money, positions, ledgers, or config. Backfill on first run reaped 4 zombie runs. Complements the paper-fill claim-ownership fix (migrations 126–128).

history.label: EdgeScout / EdgeIC — measure-only factor lab (edge/factor discovery P0+P1)
history.reason: Deterministic price/volume edge library (lib/edges/*) + Information-Coefficient gate. edge-scout computes edge_signals (cross-sectional z, no look-ahead) into edge_catalog/edge_signals/edge_signal_inputs (PIT audit)/edge_universe_members; edge-ic computes rank IC vs forward returns by horizon with Newey-West t and an advisory lifecycle status into edge_ic_history; both surfaced read-only on /dashboard/edges. MEASURE-ONLY: writes only edge_* tables, never analyst_score/agent_signals/paper fills/sizing/live orders. Migration 132 (additive). Key finding: on a broad 120-name universe the simple edges' IC collapses to ~0 (the strong 30-name signal was concentration+survivorship artifact) — the gate correctly refused to promote them. This is the LLM-demotion direction from features/edge-factor-discovery: the LLM proposes+explains; deterministic stats decide what earns capital. Not wired into trading — P2+ gated on real point-in-time, multi-regime evidence.

history.label: Money-path unification + live-exit monitor + tradable-universe blocklist (Codex audit remediation)
history.reason: Full-system audit remediation. (1) Fixed the autonomous zero-signal dead-end (wrong column + swallowed error) so it can actually place orders. (2) Unified the money path: one shared lib/trading/execute-order.ts::executeApprovedOrder(svc,input,actor) runs the full hardened invariant set for BOTH the owner manual gateway and the autonomous worker (account allowlist, fresh kill-switch, G1/G3, notional cap, drift, held-SELL, atomic v2 reservation). (3) Serverless-capable Robinhood REST adapter (lib/brokers/adapters/robinhood.ts, id 'robinhood') for submit/status/cancel. (4) NEW LiveExitMonitor (lib/trading/live-exit-monitor.ts, cron every 30m in-session both markets): auto-SELLs live positions on stop -8%/target +20%/time 15d through the gateway. (5) cancel-on-kill in broker-orders/sync. (6) Live market-open gate (lib/trading/market-calendar.ts) via authoritative AV MARKET_STATUS (US+India, catches unscheduled closures) + holiday lists. (7) Tradable-universe blocklist (migration 146, lib/trading/symbol-policy.ts): leveraged/inverse ETFs auto-blocked + owner-curated symbol_blocklist, enforced at the gateway (fail-closed BUY) + paper-trade. (8) per-market currency-correct NAV (US USD snapshot, India Kite INR), idempotent signal claim (migration 145). Deployment flag AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED stays owner-controlled.

history.label: Measure-only learning-loop groundwork (OFF by default): cross-sectional rank, PIT fundamentals ledger, historical replay harness — migrations 149/150/151 applied
history.reason: Three additive, OFF-by-default features extend the research->learner loop without changing any live agent handoff. (1) Cross-sectional rank (lib/scoring/rank.ts + research cron Pass 2, migration 151): after scoring, a deterministic second pass computes within-comparable-group percentile (market x asset-type x sector; ETFs never grouped with single names; small groups use a degraded fixed transform) and writes provenance to universe_snapshot_scores(rank_quality, comparable_group_key, group_n, rank_eligible). Gates NEW-long admission ONLY when champion genome entry.rank_pct_min>0 (default 0.0 = byte-stable selection). Preserves top-3-by-analyst_score (rank monotonic in score within a group). (2) PIT fundamentals (lib/data/pit-fundamentals.ts, table fundamental_facts migration 150): capture-on-fetch append-only vintage ledger (fail-open, dedup by payload_hash) so fundamentals-as-known-on-date-D is reconstructable; not wired into live scoring. (3) Historical replay harness (lib/replay/*, 4 tables migration 149): sealed data accessor (throws FutureDataLeakError on post-cursor data) + frozen packets replay the live eligibility gates offline to find first_eligible_asof. All three ship OFF; live money path and agent-to-agent flows unchanged.

history.label: Codex Phase-B re-review remediation: Kite verified-identity choke point + market-wide budget-lock scope + fail-closed RPC input validation
history.reason: Three safety-gate hardenings from the Codex adversarial re-review of Phase B (money-flow topology unchanged; all fail-closed only). (#2/#3) verifyKiteTradingIdentity() (lib/kite.ts) now fetches Kite /user/profile and requires the CONNECTED token's user_id to equal strategy_config.active_account_india AND an allowlisted broker_accounts{broker=kite,market=india,role=trading} row — allowlist TEXT alone no longer authorizes. Enforced at the single placeEquityOrder() choke point so the canonical/autonomous/exit paths (via kiteAdapter.submitOrder) get the same check as the standalone route (app/api/kite/order), closing the gap where the canonical path bypassed the route-level block. Fail-closed: config read err 500, unset/absent/view_only 403, profile unfetchable / user_id mismatch 502/403. (#1) migration 153 DROPS broker from the v2 budget advisory-lock key (now hashtext(local_date:market:env)) so it matches the market-wide cap it guards — two brokers in one market can no longer take different locks and jointly exceed the market cap (152 wrongly included broker). (#4) migration 153 rejects non-finite (Infinity/NaN) qty/notional/cap and validates side/env/broker/symbol/order_type enums+identifiers in the SECURITY DEFINER RPC. 153 additive over 152 (never edited). Live-path durable-ACK test added (tests/execute-order-ack.test.ts).

history.label: Daily Per-Holding Risk Analytics: deterministic per-holding risk score + posture across all live accounts, daily, advisory-only (no order path)
history.reason: New advisory analytics flow (ACCTBOOK -> HOLDINGRISK -> RISKDASH), fully off the money path. HoldingRisk (/api/agents/holding-risk, engine lib/risk/holding-risk.ts, tables holding_risk_runs/holding_risk_snapshots/account_risk_snapshots via migrations 154/155, cron migration 156 US 21:30 UTC + India 11:00 UTC) reads a read-only post-close snapshot of ALL live accounts (RH 605420660 + read-only 965848641 + Kite India), computes a deterministic risk-control pressure index 0-100 and a risk posture with strict precedence, and has an LLM write ONLY the human-readable strategy_note (cannot change score/posture/action). Fails closed on missing/stale snapshots; never sums across currencies. Surfaced on /dashboard/risk (RISKDASH) as the 'Daily Per-Holding Risk' panel with per-account tabs and honest Delta-vs-yesterday. ADVISORY-ONLY: the strategy line is wired to NO order path for any account, including read-only 965848641. No existing agent-to-agent handoff or money-flow edge changed.

history.label: Proactive broker-token health check wired into health-triage (6h) + Robinhood status route
history.reason: checkRobinhoodTokenHealth (lib/robinhood-mcp.ts) is a check that attempts a CAS refresh of the short-lived RH access token and alerts only on failed/absent refresh (no false alarm on routine short-TTL rollover) that reports/resolves the broker-token:robinhood System Health issue. Wired into POST /api/agents/health-triage BEFORE the agent_alerts read so an expired RH token is surfaced every 6h even when no order/snapshot path ran to trigger the lazy getValidAccessToken reporter, and into GET /api/robinhood-mcp/status so the Settings badge shows Reconnect required (red) on an expired token instead of a false Connected (green). Closes the gap where a dead RH refresh token silently dropped all RH accounts out of holding-risk (fetchRobinhoodBrokerAccounts returns unknown id) and froze live_account_snapshots. Advisory only: wired to no credential-write or order path; owner reconnects OAuth via localhost loopback. No money-flow edge changed.

history.label: Live account book repointed to Robinhood MCP multi-account capture (all 6 accounts)
history.reason: Risk Analytics showed no Robinhood accounts because fetchRobinhoodBrokerAccounts() (lib/brokers/index.ts) pulled holdings via the classic REST client (lib/brokers/robinhood/rest-client.ts, api.robinhood.com), which returns 401 'rejected client id' for the MCP-scoped vault token — so rhAccounts was always empty and RH fell to an 'unknown' skip, never landing in holding_risk_runs. Replaced with captureAllRobinhoodAccounts() in lib/robinhood-mcp.ts: one MCP session, get_accounts (all 6), per-account get_equity_positions + get_portfolio, batched get_equity_quotes to price holdings; returns BrokerAccount[] with real account ids. Live-verified all 6 accounts return positions+portfolio over MCP; agentic_allowed=false gates order placement only, not reads, so only 605420660 stays tradeable while all 6 are readable. Both consumers repointed: the holding-risk cron (fetchRobinhoodBrokerAccounts) and the live snapshot refresh (refreshViaMcp in app/api/live-account/refresh-snapshot/route.ts, now upserting all 6 accounts into live_account_snapshots instead of only the single active one). Codex-reviewed + fixed (negative P&L signs, ETF classification, stale-snapshot persistence, false Δ1d, VaR terminology). Shipped in 4f0bec7; ADVISORY-ONLY read path, no money-flow/order edge changed. Order placement remains restricted to 605420660.

history.label: India sentiment (GDELT) + FII/DII macro inputs; per-flow LLM; low-confidence-research quality alert
history.reason: India equities were scored with no news source and only US/global macro. Added free GDELT news tone -> India sentiment_score (honest-unavailable when <3 articles) and live NSE FII/DII net flows into the India thesis prompt. LLM per flow moved to Settings (agent_config). New low-confidence-research alert surfaces thin-data runs alongside quota alerts. FII/DII may be null on Vercel if NSE geo-throttles it — verified via /api/india/fii-dii.

history.label: Live account book now accrues a per-account daily equity curve (live_performance) for the Live-vs-VOO chart
history.reason: The Live Portfolio page needed a per-Robinhood-account portfolio-vs-VOO comparison mirroring the paper chart, but Robinhood's MCP exposes NO account-value history (get_equity_historicals is per-symbol OHLC; get_portfolio is current-only), so a true curve cannot be backfilled. Added migration 169 live_performance(account_id,date,equity,bench_nav, PK(account_id,date)) and made the snapshot refresh (refreshViaMcp, app/api/live-account/refresh-snapshot, robinhood_mcp source) upsert one row/account/day with real broker equity + that day's VOO close alongside the existing live_account_snapshots write. /api/live-portfolio/performance prefers this real series once >=2 days exist; until then it returns a labeled constant-holdings estimate (estimated:true) reconstructed from current holdings x Massive symbol history, and overlays VOO in both cases. UI (LivePortfolioPage) draws the VOO line, a '+X% vs VOO' headline, and an ESTIMATED badge. ADVISORY read/measure only — no order or money-flow edge changed.
